title: Information Systems — Electronic Flight Bag — Installation of the Standard 3 Rack and Antenna Provision

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Flight Deck Information — Electronic Flight Bag Unit

abstract: Installation of the rack position, grounding strap and antenna provision required by the standard 3 electronic flight bag unit, so that the unit itself can later be fitted as a line task.

sections.planning_reason: Chart rendering on the installed electronic flight bag takes eleven seconds, which is long enough that crews revert to paper on a busy arrival. In parallel, operators using the unit for airline data exchange have been fitting a portable antenna on a cabin window mount, which is an unapproved installation that several regulators have begun to challenge. The standard 3 unit solves both, but it needs a different rack position and an antenna aperture, and that work cannot be done on the line. This bulletin puts the provision in so that the unit change becomes a line activity.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin installs the revised rack mounting position, a new grounding strap and the antenna provision for the standard 3 unit. The rack is repositioned to give the antenna clearance, the sidewall aperture is prepared and sealed, and the harness is extended to the new position. No unit is fitted by this bulletin and the aircraft continues to operate with the existing electronic flight bag.
sections.accomplishment_summary: De-energise the flight deck avionics and remove ground power. Get access in zones 211 and 214 by removing the sidewall panel at each pilot position. Remove the existing rack D4620121177406 and mark out the revised position from the template. Drill and de-burr the mounting holes and apply the protection scheme to all bare material. Install the rack in the revised position and torque the fasteners in sequence. Prepare and seal the antenna aperture. Install the grounding strap and measure the bonding resistance, which must be below the value given in the instructions. Extend the unit harness to the new position and secure it clear of the sidewall structure as shown on drawing D46201115557. Refit the existing unit at FIN 2IS8 in the new rack position and confirm that it powers up and communicates. Restore the sidewall panels and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 Evo model aircraft delivered before the standard 3 production cut-in. The provision may be embodied on any such aircraft whether or not the operator intends to fit the standard 3 unit.
sections.material_note: Kit K4620-1005-01 contains the rack, the grounding strap, the antenna aperture seal set, the harness extension and the drill template for one aircraft. The template is returned after use. All items are short-lead.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next overnight opportunity, and in any case before the standard 3 unit is ordered.

revision_history.reason: Bonding resistance limit tightened and the harness routing corrected at the sidewall crossing in step 8
